description: MARK WHAT YOU DID ON THE CUSTOMER'S OWN GA4 CHARTS — "ad launched", "post went out", "price change" — so the traffic it moved is visible where they already look. action:'list' reads them (Google's own system annotations included, which cannot be edited or deleted), 'create' adds one on a single date or a startDate–endDate range, 'update' changes one, 'delete' removes one (confirm-gated). color: PURPLE BROWN BLUE GREEN RED CYAN ORANGE (default BLUE). Every write is read back. Free.

confirm.description: must be true to actually delete

description.description: longer note shown with the annotation (create or update)

endDate.description: last day of a range, YYYY-MM-DD; use with startDate instead of date

property.description: NUMERIC GA4 property id, from list_analytics_properties

title.description: the label on the chart. Required to create

name: manage_analytics_annotations
title: GA4 chart annotations
